name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kayzen-mcp
description: Kayzen (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a docu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_API_BASIC
environmentVariables.description: base64(<API_Key>:<API_Secret_Key>) — the Kayzen API key and secret (Kayzen UI > Account > API Key; 'Obtaining your Kayzen API key') joined by a colon and Base64-encoded, e.g. `printf '%s' 'KEY:SECRET' | base64`. Sent as `Authorization: Basic …` on POST /v1/authentication/token only.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Kayzen login email of the user the API key belongs to (token request body `username`).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Kayzen account password for that login (token request body `password`); the runtime exchanges it for a 30-minute bearer token and re-logs in on expiry or 401.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAYZEN_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kayzen advertiser id used by `me` (GET /v1/balance?advertiser_id=…). Leave empty to use the API key's default advertiser.
